title: Sealed originals on file
body: P17 | PACKET | repair note | seal intact.
Held copies go in the queue with their signatures. If the relay drops the line again, check the receipt before sending another copy.
Acknowledge receipt. Even if it took a while.
G17 | GHOST | preservation note | seal intact.
Keep the signature with the note when you move it. Otherwise the copy remembers the words and forgets whose they were.
